opportunities.title: Hakluyt Society Research Grants

amount.raw: Payments made as reimbursements of expenditure previously agreed with the relevant series editors (amount not stated)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to researchers preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society (category A) or research on proposals approved and under contract for publication (category B). Recipients of support need not be members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: The Hakluyt Society supports research undertaken in preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society, or research on proposals already approved where volumes are under contract. Payments are made as reimbursements of agreed expenditure from the Harry & Grace Smith Fund, covering research relevant to volumes for the main series (Series III) or Hakluyt Society Studies in the History of Travel.
